dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And if you have time to go to Speranza...?

dialogues.speaker: Limppu
dialogues.text: Well, if you've got a moment and the appetite, Speranza's meals are great. I ain't ashamed to admit my pastries can't measure up to a full dinner from that restaurant, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Limppu
dialogues.text: I mean, if I wasn't running this stall, and I had some time to kill, I'd head over there too!
